hypothesis: H4 (HYPOTHESES.md): measure g_x under a real LLM policy

axis_arms.why: the iso budgets move together and cannot separate the gains; the axis arms vary one axis with the others non-binding

declared_limits: g_reason is not swept; it is absorbed into the fitted p0
g_search is not exercised by this task set and is left UNMEASURED, not fitted
ref_x are E2 assumptions carried over, not measured here (see ref_sensitivity)
task SPEC is derived from the hidden suite; the assertions stay hidden
clients receive only the hidden-suite exit code, never a traceback
temperature 0 with a per-request seed; GPU sampling determinism is not exact

timing.note: wall-clock is measured per episode (time.perf_counter) and summed; it is NEVER reconstructed as mean x count

gain_fit.form: 1 - p = (1 - p0) * prod_x (1 - g_x * (1 - exp(-b_x / ref_x)))
gain_fit.refs_source: E2 assumptions (REF_ASSUMED), not measured by H4
gain_fit.note: g_* are identified only for axes the sweep actually moved out of saturation; unidentified axes are reported as such and their point estimates must not be quoted.

floor_cells_excluded_from_fit.why: no policy can be graded here: grading needs >=1 tool call and the write-before-test order needs >=2 steps
